name: Bọt Biển City #3 - Genesis Resident
description:
An original 1/1 digital artwork from Bọt Biển City Phase 1.

This piece showcases a signature genesis muse curated and illustrated directly by the architect, blending surreal ocean aesthetics with real-world spatial structures. This character is natively integrated into the Phase 2 Architectural Masterpiece as an iconic founding resident of the city.

[Collector Note]: This is a completed fine art edition. It does not accept custom portrait requests.
